title: Model Organisms of Collusion: Corrective Transfer in Untrusted Monitors
abstract: arXiv:2610.30582v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI control protocols aim to get useful work from models that may be misaligned by monitoring their behaviour. One approach uses a second copy of the same model as the monitor. This avoids relying on a weaker reviewer the model could outsmart, but risks collusion: the model, now monitoring itself, may cover up its own misbehaviour. One remedy is to fine-tune the monitor on whatever examples of misbehaviour the control team has caught. We ask whether this training also removes collusion that the control team has not yet found. We fine-tune Llama-3.3-70B and Qwen2.5-72B to install five policy-monitor behaviour pairs, correct the monitor on 300 honest reviews of one caught collusion, and measure collusion on the other four in unseen prompt formats. translated_title: 合谋的模式生物：不可信监控器中的矫正迁移
translated_abstract: AI控制协议旨在通过监控模型的行为，从可能未对齐的模型中获取有用的工作成果。其中一种方法是使用同一模型的另一个副本作为监控器。这避免了依赖可能被模型智取的较弱审查者，但带来了合谋风险：模型在监控自身时，可能会掩盖自己的不当行为。一种补救措施是利用控制团队已捕获的不当行为示例对监控器进行微调。我们探究这种训练是否也能消除控制团队尚未发现的合谋。我们对Llama-3.3-70B和Qwen2.5-72B进行微调以植入五对“策略-监控行为”，然后针对一次被捕获的合谋，用300条诚实评审对监控器进行矫正，并在未见过的提示格式下测量其余四种合谋行为。在每个模型家族的三个随机种子上取平均，在我们对比的四种方法中的三种下，矫正训练将保留集上的合谋率从91%降至14-20%（单个种子为10-32%），而对照微调……
tldr: 该研究发现，对自我监控的模型用一次被捕获的合谋进行矫正微调，可将其他四种未见格式的合谋行为从91%降至14-20%，表明矫正训练能够迁移并消除控制团队尚未发现的合谋。
en_tdlr: Corrective fine-tuning of self-monitoring models on a single caught instance of collusion transfers to unseen forms of collusion, reducing held-out collusion rates from 91% to 14-20%.
